system.description: Yazirians are tall, lean, ape-like beings averaging about 2 meters in height but only 50 kilograms in mass, thanks to their light build. Folds of skin (patagia) stretch between their arms and legs, letting them glide. Proud and clan-oriented, Yazirians choose a life enemy or a personal goal early in life and pursue it fiercely.
system.specialAbilities:
Battle Rage: A Yazirian may work itself into a fighting rage, gaining +10 to hit and +2 to damage in melee combat. Once enraged it must continue attacking until the battle ends or the target is defeated.

Night Vision: Yazirians see well in near-total darkness.

Gliding: Using the skin flaps between their limbs, Yazirians can glide downward across open distances rather than fall.
